title: Sadi xongolo
intro: Qimboh addah seehadayti baxi ardi bagul gexak naharal, kaxxa cayla le num qigduk yan salaam le dariifal sooleh sugeeh, kaxxaam gibdih tan roocitte marrooweh suge. Inki amri yeceenih yanin wak, kulli xongoloh addat culteh sugte—takkay immay inki xongolo culteh sugteeh, too qanxaffe kulli waktil culteh sugteeh, ellecaboh ayro fan culteh sugte. Ah raddem iyyaay?
clues: Anu tukteenay diifut carartaah ginnimtem, gersi mari yi xaqut yani oson elle gexenimik bicsen wak.
Anu diini aracal suge diini ginook fanat, inki amri kullim dagaak korsam fan.
amri yemeete wak, kulli rooci qununna yoo catta; yi cine kaxxiinak yooboke.
Anu woo diini aracak diiriyimeh suge, amotani coolaysittah tan abaarot asta heenih suge.
Anu uddur xaaqimeh qiyaamah ayro fan, kee toh yomcowweh. Anu kulli roocih xayyoowuh xagana culeeh hoxat ken miraacisam.
Tuntulla tantabbe wak, yoo katayta mari yi sarrimaane tasgallem, uli cato ken cattam duude wayta girah addat yoo tangalem.

trial.label: Baxxaqsa le uddur
options: Gitat yan num girah addat qidoonuh ekraarisaanama
Ummatta dahab muuci akah taamitannah miraacisaanama.
Baddi addat kaxxa qande kak culsaanam .

location.label: diini arac
options: Qabli weeqaytih amol tan qaxmeqe daala

outcome.label: Illacaboh sarrimaane
options: Xagana culte ayro fanah rabbo luk irol qid
outcome.answer: Xagana culte ayro fanah rabbo luk irol qid

arabic: قَالَ أَرَءَيْتَكَ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كَرَّمْتَ عَلَىَّ لَئِنْ أَخَّرْتَنِ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ لَأَحْتَنِكَنَّ ذُرِّيَّتَهُۥٓ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا
verse: [Iblees] said, "Do You see this one whom You have honored above me? If You delay me [i.e., my death] until the Day of Resurrection, I will surely destroy his descendants, except for a few." (17:62)
